properties.name: add_change_event now takes summary and rationale. THE DESIGN WAS RIGHT AND THE CODE WAS WRONG, which is defect_fix's own definition: ChangeEvent has declared summary (indexed, embedding field) and rationale since the schema was written, and the constructor took neither — so the only way to record why a change happened was a second write. Two projects reported the same workaround on 2026-08-19.
